text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Three years have gone by in a flash. At
times, it
felt like Yukino Bijin and I
would get caught up in
the hype
surrounding her. Other times, it felt like

the pressure might crush us.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, the love of the people around
her, the
trust of her friends, and her own
determination all
helped her to
overcome these obstacles.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's grown significantly after three
whole years,
and now...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
You can do it, Mifuyu! Good luck on
your jumps!

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
Will she be able to achieve her dream of
reaching
the world championship?! Here
comes a triple
axel! And Mifuyu pulls it
off perfectly!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Jeepers! What a jump!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Did you see that just now?! Mifuyu's the
berries!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mifuyu, Yukino Bijin's best friend, has
entered a
tournament in an attempt to
qualify for the world
championship she
dreams of competing in.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I've got goose pimples all over... No way
she
won't qualify after jump'n like that!

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
And there you have it! Mifuyu has taken
a solid
step toward her dream and seized
a spot at the
world championship!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: YIPPEEE!

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
She never gave up despite numerous
setbacks,
and now, at long last, she's
standing at the
starting line of her
dream!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Isn't Mifuyu just... just...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yeah, she really is!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
She's always been so sparkly, and she's
the
bestest friend I could ever ask for!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad I got t'watch her take this
step... Now,
I'll be able t'do my best
t'morrow too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin has been invited to
participate in
special exhibition race
tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With big-name racers like Oguri Cap and
Inari
One participating, Yukino Bijin
might find herself
struggling to get any
time in the spotlight.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Are you nervous about t'morrow,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah, sorry. It's just...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'm glad it's finally my turn t'support you!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Up till now, you've been the one push'n
me
forward and cheer'n me on.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: There's nothing t'worry about, Trainer! The other racers are pretty incredible...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
But I'm gonna get results that'll put a
smile on
your face!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
We've poured our hearts and souls into
train'n, so
there's no doubt that
everything'll be just dandy!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I've got this, so just sit back and watch
me win!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You betcha!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And now, to introduce today's lineup in
this
celebration of dreams! These
Umamusume have it
all, from popularity
to raw talent!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Good luck, Yukino!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the crowd is going wild for the Snow
Angel,
Yukino Bijin! She's certainly
earned her spot in
this race after
consistently proving herself these
past
three years!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure all her fans here can expect
another
fantastic performance!

text_block_list.name: Villagers
text_block_list.text: Yukinooo! You can do iiit!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Fans A and B
text_block_list.text: Good luck, Yukino! You've got this!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Thanks for cheer'n for me, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
No idea how I'll fare against all these big
wigs
here today, but...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna give it everyth'n I got and
bring home
the gold!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Cheese and crackers! Now those butterflies're in my stomach!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I know, but now I can't stop my knees
from
knock'n together...
choice_data_list: さっきまで堂々としてたじゃないか
さっきまで堂々としてたじゃない

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I can't b'lieve I'm gonna be runn'n with
all those
stars... What if I muck it all up?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
choice_data_list: “シチーガール”だったらどうする？

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Well... A city girl wouldn't get flustered
over
someth'n like this.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
That's right. Hav'n all these eyes on me
is the
perfect chance to win over some
fans!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm okay now, Trainer. Just hang tight
and wait
for my triumphant return!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin may appear as pure and
delicate as
snow, but that fragile
appearance belies great
strength.
Whatever path she decides to walk, I'll

be there to watch over her.
